Bug-fix release for terminal input lifecycle and notification retention.

Requires Zig **0.16.0**.

## Fixed

- Preserve queued input and already-generated task results, timer notifications,
  and frame notifications across normal input stop/start, including foreground
  command handoff.
- Preserve input failures returned by libvaxis across stop/start races. Chasen
  cancels outstanding work, reclaims resources, and restores the terminal before
  returning the error from `run` or `runWith`.
- Keep libvaxis' existing read retries without adding Chasen-level reader
  recovery or admission retries.

## Dependency update

- Update libvaxis to commit
  [173a890](https://github.com/rockorager/libvaxis/commit/173a890d1394946b5d7623c66cd34bcd36d8eeb8).

## Compatibility notes

Custom POSIX `std.Io` configurations need at least two simultaneous terminal
slots: one for libvaxis' SIGWINCH handler and one for the input reader. Tasks,
timers, and frames require additional capacity. Two slots do not guarantee that
a finite backend can immediately admit a restarted reader; admission failures
are returned after cleanup. Use the default Threaded configuration for ordinary
operation. See [runtime configuration](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.2/docs/RUNTIME.md#runtime-configuration).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
